svg.title: Capability Scout demo
svg.desc: Replay of a real Claude Code session from the live test. The prompt asks for a security review of app.py without modifying files. Claude first answers with a capability plan: it uses its own read-only review and names a first-party security plugin worth adding, which it has not installed. Then it lists prioritized fixes, starting with command injection and an exposed debugger, and says it modified no files.
svg.text: Claude Code · replayed from a real test session (ts1-stage1-default-ABC-0328)
